title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Projects to Improve Public Infrastructure in El Salvador

description.narrative:
The development and strengthening of logistical and transportation infrastructure has a positive impact both on economic development and poverty reduction. Transportation infrastructure is of vital importance to the standard of living of a population.

When the fundamental criteria of sustainability, participation and transparency are complied with, investing in infrastructure leads to an investment in human development. UNOPS in El Salvador is the central resource for public works and physical infrastructure development, offering technical assistance for projects to improve the “Monseñor Óscar Arnulfo Romero y Galdámez” international airport of El Salvador.

This work has multiple benefits for El Salvador´s citizens. Hundreds of people are employed directly, while 1,500 ancillary positions are created. The quality and safety of transportation is strengthened for the more than 2.4 million passengers who use the service every year, while maintaining the high standard of service made available to visitors, airlines and workers, with a beneficial impact on transportation, competitiveness and growth.
